title: friendsframe
summary: The social window implements the FriendsFrame shell, Friends/Who/Guild/Raid tabs, Friends/Ignore inset toggle, reference row counts and online details, add/remove/ignore/invite flows, Who columns/search/results, and the selected-friend Send Message route. FriendsFrameUiLaw owns the 384x512 window seat, action rectangles and contact gates. ADD_FRIEND/ADD_IGNORE now occupy the shared two-slot StaticPopup seat with exact law-owned text/edit/button geometry, authored chat-input border slices, twelve-letter cap, OnShow focus, and distinct Enter/Accept/Cancel/Escape routing instead of an ad-hoc in-panel ImGui box.

openItems.text: No Send Message button (BenillaFriendsFrameSendMessageButton) - whispering a selected friend requires typing /w manually
openItems.resolution: The exact 131x21 Send Message button at (214,384) opens the chat edit box prefilled `/w <selected name> ` and, like current Benilla, is enabled only for a selected online friend (also waiting for MSUI's asynchronous name resolution).

openItems.text: Live-verify ADD_FRIEND/ADD_IGNORE visual placement, focus, twelve-letter cap, Enter/Accept/Cancel/Escape wire cardinality, and stacking with a second StaticPopup.
